correctness.rationale: For a simple graph incidence poset, a graph vertex is up beat exactly at degree one; deleting such a leaf makes its unique incident edge down beat. The paired deletions reproduce graph leaf pruning. The terminal 2-core incidence poset has no beat points because every surviving vertex has at least two incomparable incident edges and every edge has two incomparable endpoints; each tree component leaves one isolated point. Stong core uniqueness then gives the homotopy classification. The symbolic proof covers all finite simple graphs, while verify.py only checks finite boundary cases.

value.rationale: This is a natural complete classification for a standard construction: the canonical graph 2-core is identified exactly with the strong finite-space homotopy core of the incidence poset, while tree components contribute only isolated points. It yields an immediate decision criterion for finite-space homotopy of incidence posets and explains why this homotopy notion retains substantially more information than ordinary graph homotopy type. The invariant and reduction are standardly motivated, not an arbitrary finite slice.
